parameters.name: admin
parameters.description: Whether the user should be in the admin role or not. Since version 2.8, the role is also updated. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: grants
parameters.description: Privileges to grant to this user. Takes a list of dicts containing the “database” and “privilege” keys. If this argument is not provided, the current grants are left alone. If an empty list is provided, all grants for the user are removed.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.description: The hostname or IP address on which InfluxDB server is listening. Default: "localhost"

parameters.name: password
parameters.description: Password that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server. Default: "root"

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The path on which InfluxDB server is accessible. Only available when using python-influxdb >= 5.1.0. Default: ""

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The port on which InfluxDB server is listening. Default: 8086

parameters.name: proxies
parameters.description: HTTP(S) proxy to use for Requests to connect to InfluxDB server. Default: {}

parameters.name: retries
parameters.description: Number of retries client performs before aborting. 0 indicates try until success. Only available when using python-influxdb >= 4.1.0. Default: 3

parameters.name: ssl
parameters.description: Use https instead of http to connect to InfluxDB server. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: Number of seconds Requests waits for client to establish a connection.

parameters.name: udp_port
parameters.description: UDP port to connect to InfluxDB server. Default: 4444

parameters.name: use_udp
parameters.description: Use UDP to connect to InfluxDB server. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: user_password
parameters.description: Password to be set for the user.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Username that is used to authenticate against InfluxDB server. Default: "root"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: If set to false, the SSL certificates are not validated. This should only set to false used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create a user on localhost using default login credentials
  community.general.influxdb_user:
    user_name: john
    user_password: s3cr3t

- name: Create a user on localhost using custom login credentials
  community.general.influxdb_user:
    user_name: john
    user_password: s3cr3t
    login_username: "{{ influxdb_username }}"
    login_password: "{{ influxdb_password }}"

- name: Create an admin user on a remote host using custom login credentials
  community.general.influxdb_user:
    user_name: john
    user_password: s3cr3t
    admin: true
    hostname: "{{ influxdb_hostname }}"
    login_username: "{{ influxdb_username }}"
    login_password: "{{ influxdb_password }}"

- name: Create a user on localhost with privileges
  community.general.influxdb_user:
    user_name: john
    user_password: s3cr3t
    login_username: "{{ influxdb_username }}"
    login_password: "{{ influxdb_password }}"
    grants:
      - database: 'collectd'
        privilege: 'WRITE'
      - database: 'graphite'
        privilege: 'READ'

- name: Destroy a user using custom login credentials
  community.general.influxdb_user:
    user_name: john
    login_username: "{{ influxdb_username }}"
    login_password: "{{ influxdb_password }}"
    state: absent
